info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizdoc-List Pharmacy Prescriptions Interactions-v1-spec
info.description: The Pharmacy Prescription Interactions API enables users to access and retrieve detailed information about potential interactions between prescribed medications. This API serves pharmacies, healthcare providers, and software developers focused on medication management and patient safety. Utilizing this endpoint, developers can integrate interaction data into various applications, helping to ensure that patients receive safe and effective medication combinations. The API supports routine checks and assessments, improving overall healthcare outcomes by reducing the risks associated with prescription interactions.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to access detailed information about potential interactions between different prescribed medications. It aims to help healthcare professionals and patients make informed decisions regarding medication management.
